factualPassageReview.method: Read only the four named original, selected and restored HTML files. Verified exact original/sanitized hash mappings, byte equality of every segment outside all eight declared nonce/_wpnonce replacement ranges, full decoded text equality excluding script/style bodies, selected factual witnesses, and exact restored-copy equality. No capture-tree scan or production execution.
factualPassageReview.factualScope: Preserves City advertisement naming/currently-available wording and copyright scope; public 2025 CHOICE drive/acceleration/cargo/categorical towing; exact GLB WLTP grades and third-row-folded/front-cargo scope; GLC exact price exclusion, range, drivetrain, acceleration and cargo seating scope. This is preservation review, not an evidence regrade or new current-supply attestation.
limitations: Sanitized files have different bytes and SHA256 values; they cannot satisfy original capture pins.
The original research, source-capture manifest and working originals are unchanged. This receipt does not amend them.
Future restoration replay requires the unavailable original bytes or a separately reviewed replacement manifest and provenance review; no silent original-hash equivalence.
This bounded check does not attest residual credential scanning, archive/upload integrity or other backup members; those remain the backup verifier scope.
No original removed nonce/runtime value is included in this receipt.
